as far as, up to, even to

strongs.def: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
strongs.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet
strongs.from: properly, the same as H5703 (עַד) (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition)
